free_text: Despite the prior positive biopsy, the high PI-RADS 5 score and the rising PSA trend from 4.5 to 10.92 ng/mL strongly support further investigation. The prior positive diagnosis does not preclude re-sampling when imaging features are highly suspicious and PSA is progressing. The room converged on proceeding with a biopsy to better characterize the lesion and guide definitive management.
